next.reason: 1985 Table 1 makes PICTURE mandatory in every format 3 row and permits JUSTIFIED, BLANK WHEN ZERO and GROUP INDICATE with SOURCE while COLUMN is optional; USAGE is not permitted on an unprintable SUM entry. 2023: 'The PICTURE clause may be omitted ... when an alphanumeric, boolean or national literal ... is specified in the VALUE clause' (§2023:13.15.3 SR14) - looser; 'If BLANK WHEN ZERO or JUSTIFIED is specified, a COLUMN clause shall also be specified' (§2023:13.15.3 SR15) and GROUP INDICATE needs 'a COLUMN clause and a SOURCE or VALUE clause' (§2023:13.18.28.3 SR1) - stricter; USAGE is offered in every entry (§2023:13.15.2). Kept: PICTURE with SOURCE or SUM (§2023:13.15.3 SR12), COLUMN with VALUE (SR13), COLUMN needs SOURCE, VALUE or SUM (SR10), these clauses only in elementary entries (SR11). All compile-time.
